blurb: The DREAM Park offers boarding facilities with heated stalls and multiple arenas for riding and events. It hosts horse shows, clinics, dog shows, festivals, and community events year-round. Programs include private and group riding lessons, summer camps, and therapeutic riding for special needs individuals.
extraNote: 5% discount for Gloucester County residents on boarding rates, cannot combine discounts · 5% discount for boarding multiple horses, cannot combine discounts · Open year round, seven days a week, 51 weeks out of the year
